body.description: Required QA-persona signature for this assigned practice document only. Not a real employment, background, identity or credential certificate.
body.htmlContent:
SYNTHETIC NLU QA ONLY

This is a fictional practice acknowledgement, not a real employment offer, background check, identity document or training credential.

I will use my own assigned QA persona and review the document and its current revision before choosing my own signature. I will not copy another person's signature or mark an incomplete requirement finished.

I will review the planned child count, record actual observed counts and clock only my own actual QA work. The app's required review remains in place when information is missing or disputed. No child names or real family information belong in this exercise.

Creating a password does not activate an employee account. Childcare work and scheduling also require the separate authorized service assignment and approved compensation terms.

This acknowledgement applies only to the displayed synthetic practice document.

body: SYNTHETIC NLU QA ONLY. No real child, employment or payroll record is represented.

Review the planned child count on the exact shift. When asked whether the planned number was present, confirm truthfully or enter the actual observed number. Keep a correction reviewable instead of changing history.
Clock in and out only for your own actual QA work. Scheduled time is not proof that work occurred. A scheduled co-caregiver who has not clocked in is not an active caregiver.
Use only your own permissions, documents and pay information. Ask the authorized manager to review a disputed count or missing pay readiness.
A saved password does not activate employment. Finish the actual required onboarding and wait for the separate staff review. This practice module does not replace required company training.
